scope: Acceptance criteria written before inspecting pressure-run outcomes
rule: Stages 3 and 4 cannot pass unless all runs complete 0.1 MPa and hold with all solver checks passing; prefix agreement alone is diagnostic. Tolerances are developer numerical choices, not measured material accuracy.
edge_resolution_meaning: Endpoint must lie within tolerance times EE separation of the source closest point and have matching opposing feature and gap; linear motion certificate remains unchanged.
